title: Why a small temperature rise speeds reactions so much
caption: At the higher temperature the distribution flattens and shifts to higher energy. The area beyond Ea, the molecules that can react, grows far more than the shift suggests: here it more than doubles.
alt: Two Maxwell–Boltzmann energy distributions, T₁ and a higher T₂, with the area beyond Ea shaded for each; the T₂ tail is much larger.
description: T₁: taller, narrower, peak further left.
T₂: lower, broader, peak further right.
Beyond Ea: the T₂ curve lies well above the T₁ curve.

checks.name: beyond Ea, T₂ has more than twice as many molecules as T₁
